skillset.skill: 12s CT - 2500% Water DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by 30. If own HP is below 40%, increase own Arts by 50 instead.
skillset.arts: 18000% Water DMG (PHY). For 25s, increase allies' DEF and Equip CT Speed by 30%.
skillset.truearts: 43000% Water DMG (PHY). For 30s, redirect Allies' DMG taken to self and gain a DMG barrier that negates 37000 DMG to self.
skillset.superarts: 100000% Water DMG (PHY). For 45s, increase allies' ATK and PHY DMG based on how low own HP is (MAX: 300%).

passive.ability1: Increase Female allies' Arts by 4/s. When near-death, increase Female allies' Arts by 6/s instead. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability2: When this unit takes lethal DMG, prevent HP from dropping below 1 HP for 3s and heal own HP by 100%. Ability can only be activated twice per Quest.
passive.ability3: When near-death, increase DMG RES by 35%.
passive.ability5: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Sayaka Miki's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability6: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Sayaka Miki's SP. Art is owned)

trueweapon.name: Sayaka's Sword
trueweapon.skill: 40s CT - 8000% Water DMG (PHY). For 10s, increase own Water DMG and Skill CT Speed by 50%.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Sayaka, increase own stats by 20%, and Freeze RES and Paralysis RES by 100%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability2: When near-death, increase own Evasion rate by 5%.
